summary: One or two sentences: what this PR does, as you understood it.

checked.area: Short name of a rule, contract or risk this PR touches
checked.result: What you verified and what you found, one sentence.

cross_repo.result: What you verified on the other side of the contract, with file:line when you cite code.

heads_up: A real, non-blocking risk the author would want to know. Usually empty.

read: files or dirs read in full

resolved: Recheck only: a blocker from the previous review that is now fixed.

blockers.title: What breaks
blockers.when: Concrete scenario: when X, Y happens.

reason: UNREVIEWED only: why the PR could not be reviewed.
